title: Compatibility manifest
description: What one component supports, advertised during authenticated readiness. Client-installed extension and SDK components publish their manifest; missing required compatibility fails readiness, and there is no lower-fidelity substitution. Additive optional fields may stay inside a major; removed, renamed, newly required, or semantically changed fields require a new one.

envelope.description: Envelope majors the component can produce and consume.

payloads.description: Per payload type support. A payload type absent from this list is unsupported.

contract_support.description: The majors one contract supports, ordered most preferred first. Preference is the ordering rather than a separate field, so a component can never prefer a major it does not support.

major_support.description: One supported major, carrying its deprecation window when one is announced.

payload_support.description: Support for one area-namespaced payload type.

deprecation_window.description: One announced window. The major stays accepted until sunset_at, after which peers using it fail readiness with the incompatible_version category.
